phase_frame.behavior: Configured libexecdir feeds DRIVER_DEFINES -DSTANDARD_LIBEXEC_PREFIX="$(libexecdir)/gcc/" (or patched gcc-cross). CFLAGS-gcc.o += DRIVER_DEFINES. COMPILE.base orders ALL_COMPILERFLAGS then ALL_CPPFLAGS; ALL_CXXFLAGS has object-specific flags before CXXFLAGS/INTERNAL_CFLAGS/@DEFS@, and ALL_CPPFLAGS includes CPPFLAGS. Configure pass_vars passes compiler flags as environment assignments; native recursive make passes flags as make command-line assignments.
phase_frame.known: Precise later preservation/override surfaces are localized. rules2:80 uses a word-based filter for environment, selecting both origin environment and the two-word origin environment override. unsetenv unexports and performs an ordinary empty assignment.
phase_frame.override_classification: Under ordinary GNU make language interpretation, command-line origin does not match filter environment and is not cleared. With make -e, environment override DOES match that word-based filter, but an ordinary file assignment to empty is not proof that the higher-priority environment value was superseded; unexport governs export and pass_vars explicitly reads/passes nonempty values. Relevant actual make flags/origins therefore remain a preservation premise. File/target/object-specific definitions and forced/includes/@DEFS@ can also affect the macro after DRIVER_DEFINES. These are possible surfaces, not observed actual overrides or a new GNU-conformance premise.
